raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

MegaAttn's (`FLASHMLA_MEGA_ATTN_DSV41`) `wo_a` einsum now writes `z` directly as MXFP8, together with the F8_128x4 UE8M0 scales that `wo_b`'s FlashInfer MXFP8 GEMM reads. `wo_b` therefore no longer quantizes a BF16 `z`, at any token count. It uses vllm-project/DeepGEMM#40 (merged), which adds the 128x4 scale layout to DeepGEMM's FP8 einsum epilogue. This PR bumps the DeepGEMM pin to it.

## Claims

- `_o_proj` drops the standalone `mxfp8_quantize` kernel. On GB200 it is 0.4-2.0 us per layer faster in decode (1-256 tokens) and 2.8-141 us faster in prefill (512-32768 tokens). The one regression is +0.6 us at 384 tokens (see Details).
- `wo_b` receives byte-identical FP8 data and scales, so model outputs do not change.
- Only `flash_mla_mega_attn.py` changes (+33/-5 lines vs main). Shared o_proj code and other backends are untouched.

## Validation

`_o_proj` alone (`wo_a` einsum, then `wo_b` CuTe-DSL MXFP8 GEMM) at DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash TP1 shapes: 8 groups x 4096 -> 1024, `wo_b` 8192 -> 5120. Setup: 1 x GB200, CUPTI, full CUDA graph, cold L2, median of 3 rounds, both arms in one process. Software: torch 2.13.0+cu132, FlashInfer 0.7.0.post1, DeepGEMM a7a9277 + DeepGEMM#40. Outputs are bitwise identical at all 20 sizes measured.

| tokens | main (us) | this PR (us) | delta (us) | main: einsum BF16 + quant (us) | PR: einsum FP8 (us) |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 26.2 | 24.9 | -1.3 | 10.9 + 2.4 | 11.2 |
| 4 | 25.5 | 23.8 | -1.7 | 10.9 + 2.4 | 11.2 |
| 16 | 26.1 | 24.1 | -2.0 | 11.0 + 2.5 | 11.3 |
| 64 | 29.9 | 28.1 | -1.8 | 12.4 + 2.7 | 13.0 |
| 128 | 29.3 | 28.8 | -0.5 | 13.3 + 2.9 | 14.8 |
| 256 | 46.8 | 45.1 | -1.7 | 14.3 + 3.6 | 14.5 |
| 384 | 42.3 | 42.9 | +0.6 | 17.9 + 4.6 | 22.3 |
| 512 | 58.5 | 55.6 | -2.8 | 20.0 + 4.9 | 20.7 |
| 1024 | 77.7 | 73.2 | -4.5 | 33.4 + 7.7 | 34.1 |
| 4096 | 250.1 | 229.8 | -20.3 | 105.4 + 20.6 | 104.5 |
| 8192 | 497.4 | 454.5 | -42.9 | 216.8 + 36.2 | 210.5 |
| 16384 | 1010.0 | 906.5 | -103.5 | 439.5 + 68.2 | 430.4 |
| 32768 | 2127.5 | 1986.9 | -140.6 | 936.5 + 129.8 | 903.3 |

The previous revision of this PR wrote MN-major scales, swizzled them with a separate Triton kernel (1.6-5.2 us per call), and was gated to 1024+ tokens. The E2E prefill (DEP4) and accuracy results below were measured on that previous revision and were not re-run. This revision only removes the swizzle kernel from the same prefill path, and it hands `wo_b` the same bytes. Decode E2E has not been measured.

<details>
<summary>Previous revision: E2E prefill (DEP4, GB300) and accuracy</summary>

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, DEP4 (DP4 x TP1 + EP) on one GB300 node. Default config: SWA bounded replay on, MegaAttn, DeepGEMM mega MoE, fp8 KV cache, `max_num_batched_tokens=16384`, prefix caching off. Offline `LLM` per DP rank, one random-token prompt per rank, `max_tokens=1`. TTFT is measured from `scheduled_ts` to `first_token_ts` on the slowest rank; median of 3 repeats after a warmup.

| tokens/rank | base run 1 (ms) | base run 2 (ms) | PR (ms) | vs base mean |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1024 | 58.7 | 56.4 | 57.9 | +0.5% (noise) |
| 4096 | 93.1 | 92.9 | 91.4 | -1.7% |
| 8192 | 134.7 | 135.0 | 133.5 | -1.0% |
| 16384 | 229.1 | 227.9 | 227.4 | -0.5% |
| 32768 | 421.1 | 421.9 | 419.5 | -0.5% |

| eval | setup | score |
|---|---|---|
| GSM8K | lm-eval 0.4.13, 1319 problems, 5-shot, temperature 0, 4096-token cap, concurrency 32 | strict match 92.80%, flexible extract 92.72% (±0.7) |
| GPQA Diamond | gpt-oss `GPQAEval`, 198 problems, 0-shot chat, thinking on, temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95 | 89.90% (±2.1) |

</details>

Tests:
- vllm-project/DeepGEMM#40: all 7 tests in `tests/test_einsum.py` pass, including the new bitwise check of the 128x4 scales against the MN-major path.
- `tests/kernels/test_dsv41_mega_attn_layouts.py::test_quantized_o_proj_matches_quantized_bf16` now covers 1, 129 and 8193 tokens (decode, partial and multiple 128-row tiles), including CUDA graph capture and replay. It checks that `_o_proj`'s FP8 data and valid-row scales are byte-identical to `wo_b` quantizing the BF16 `z`. All 5 tests in the file pass on 1 x GB200 (torch 2.14.0+cu132, DeepGEMM with #40): `pytest tests/kernels/test_dsv41_mega_attn_layouts.py -v`.
- `pre-commit` (ruff, format, typos, shellcheck, mypy) passes.

## Details

- **Why the gate is gone.** DeepGEMM's einsum could only write MN-major packed scales, so `wo_b` needed a separate swizzle kernel. Below about 1024 tokens, that launch cost about as much as the quantization it saved. vllm-project/DeepGEMM#40 changes only the scale address in the einsum epilogue, so no extra kernel is left.
- **Gate conditions (unchanged).** The path runs when the einsum uses the per-32 recipe, `o_lora_rank % 128 == 0`, and `wo_b` is an MXFP8 kernel that accepts F8_128x4 scales (`can_fuse_query_quant`). It also requires no GEMM-RS, because the fused GEMM + reduce-scatter takes a BF16 `z` only.
- **Padded scale rows.** Rows past the last token in the final 128-row tile are not written. They only feed `wo_b` output rows that are never stored, so the test compares valid rows only.
- **384 tokens.** At 128-384 tokens (and at 2048 tokens), DeepGEMM's FP8-output einsum is slower than its BF16-output einsum, for example 17.9 -> 22.3 us at 384. The old MN-major scales show the same slowdown, so it is independent of this change. It is a DeepGEMM kernel-selection issue that can be fixed there.
- **DeepGEMM pin.** The pin points at `727f847`, the merge commit of DeepGEMM#40 on the fork's `dev` branch. The einsum selects the 128x4 scales with `use_128x4_sfd_layout=True`, which an older externally installed `deep_gemm` (vLLM prefers site-packages) does not accept.
- Merged `main` to resolve conflicts.

---

</details>

 import torch

     torch.testing.assert_close(
         fused_o @ loaded_weight.T, expected, rtol=1e-3, atol=1e-3
     )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100),
+    reason="Mega attention requires SM100",
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tokens,groups", [(1, 8), (129, 1), (8193, 8)])
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_quantized_o_proj_matches_quantized_bf16(tokens, groups):
+    """wo_a's MXFP8 output equals wo_b quantizing the BF16 z, also on replay."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fusion.quant_activation import QuantizedActivation
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.mxfp8_utils import (
+        mxfp8_e4m3_quantize,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.flash_mla_mega_attn import (
+        DeepseekV4MegaAttnAttention,
+        alloc_mega_attn_output,
+    )
+
+    def ue8m0_near_one(*shape):
+        return torch.randint(121, 128, shape, device="cuda").to(torch.uint8)
+
+    torch.manual_seed(7)
+    k, n = 4096, 1024
+    o = alloc_mega_attn_output(tokens, groups, torch.device("cuda"))
+    o.data.copy_(torch.randn(o.data.shape, device="cuda").to(o.data.dtype))
+    o.scale.copy_(ue8m0_near_one(tokens, groups, k // 32).view(torch.int32))
+    weight_scale = torch.empty((groups, k // 128, n), device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+    weight_scale = weight_scale.transpose(1, 2)
+    weight_scale.copy_(ue8m0_near_one(groups, n, k // 32).view(torch.int32))
+
+    def wo_b(z):
+        if isinstance(z, QuantizedActivation):
+            return z.data, z.scale
+        return mxfp8_e4m3_quantize(z, is_sf_swizzled_layout=True)
+
+    layer = SimpleNamespace(
+        n_local_groups=groups,
+        o_lora_rank=n,
+        wo_a=SimpleNamespace(
+            weight=torch.randn(groups, n, k, device="cuda").to(torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+            weight_scale=weight_scale,
+        ),
+        _einsum_recipe=(1, 1, 32),
+        _wo_b_proj=wo_b,
+    )
+
+    def projection(quantize):
+        layer._can_quantize_o_proj = quantize
+        return DeepseekV4MegaAttnAttention._o_proj(layer, o, None)
+
+    def scale_rows(scale):
+        # F8_128x4 words back to one row per token; padded rows are unwritten.
+        words = scale.view(torch.int32).view(-1, groups * n // 128, 32, 4)
+        return words.permute(0, 3, 2, 1).reshape(-1, groups * n // 128)[:tokens]
+
+    def assert_same(actual, expected):
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            actual[0].view(torch.uint8), expected[0].view(torch.uint8)
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(scale_rows(actual[1]), scale_rows(expected[1]))
+
+    assert_same(projection(True), projection(False))
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        graph_output = projection(True)
+    o.data.copy_((torch.randn(o.data.shape, device="cuda") * 0.3).to(o.data.dtype))
+    graph.replay()
+    assert_same(graph_output, projection(False))

@@ -221,19 +223,46 @@ def _o_proj(
         einsum consumes the kernel's output with no repacking.
         """

+        quantize = self._can_quantize_o_proj
         z = torch.empty(
-            (attn_out.data.shape[0], groups, self.o_lora_rank),
-            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            (num_tokens, groups, self.o_lora_rank),
+            dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn if quantize else torch.bfloat16,
             device=attn_out.data.device,
         )
+        if quantize:
+            # wo_a writes wo_b's MXFP8 input with F8_128x4 UE8M0 scales. Padded
+            # scale rows stay unwritten and only reach wo_b rows it never stores.
+            z_scale = torch.empty(
+                (cdiv(num_tokens, 128), groups * self.o_lora_rank // 128, 128),
+                dtype=torch.int32,
+                device=z.device,
+            )
         fp8_einsum(
             "bhr,hdr->bhd",
             (attn_out.data[:, :groups], attn_out.scale[:, :groups]),
             (self.wo_a.weight, self.wo_a.weight_scale),
-            z,
+            (z, z_scale) if quantize else z,
             recipe=self._einsum_recipe,
+            use_128x4_sfd_layout=quantize,
+        )

+            return self._wo_b_proj(z)
+        scale = z_scale.view(-1).view(torch.uint8)
+        return self._wo_b_proj(
+            QuantizedActivation(z, scale, torch.bfloat16, z.shape, kMxfp8Dynamic)
+        )
+

+        return (
+            self._einsum_recipe == (1, 1, 32)
+            and self.o_lora_rank % 128 == 0
+            # The fused GEMM + reduce-scatter takes a BF16 z only.
+            and self.gemm_rs is None

         )
-        return self._wo_b_proj(z.flatten(1))
